chapters.title: Sales Log: every sale, day by day
chapters.text: This is the Sales Log. It lists every sale, day by day, newest first. The green row is today.

chapters.title: At closing: tap + CC and type the cash you counted
chapters.text: At closing, count the cash. Tap plus C C, type the amount, and press Enter.

chapters.title: WNW = cash counted minus sales
chapters.text: W N W shows the difference between the cash and the sales written down. Orange means there is more cash than sales recorded. Red means the cash is short.

chapters.title: Each sale: customer, price, cost, profit
chapters.text: Under it, each sale shows the customer, the price, the cost and the profit. A tick in W A means the WhatsApp message was sent.

chapters.title: Tap a receipt number to view or reprint it
chapters.text: When a sale is on a receipt, its number shows under the customer. Tap it to view or reprint the receipt.

chapters.title: Wrong sale? Tap undo
chapters.text: To cancel a wrong sale, tap the undo arrow. The sale turns red and is marked cancelled.

chapters.title: Older sales: pick a Period
chapters.text: To see older sales, tap Period and pick a year, then a month. The Sales Log goes back to twenty twenty three.

chapters.title: Grey REC rows are older records (view only)
chapters.text: Older records show in grey, marked R E C. They can be viewed, but not changed. A paperclip means a photo of that day's form is attached. Tap it to see it.

chapters.title: Back to the last 90 days
chapters.text: To come back to recent sales, pick Last ninety days.

chapters.title: Receipt…, + Past sale and the chart
chapters.text: On the bar, Receipt makes one receipt from sales you tick. Plus Past sale records a sale from an earlier day. And the chart button opens analytics.

chapters.title: Law: check the Sales Log at closing
chapters.text: Now the laws of the Sales Log. Check the Sales Log at closing: every sale of the day is there, the cash is counted and matches, and any difference is written down and told to Joe before leaving. One point.

chapters.title: Wrong tap: undo it the same day. 3 points
chapters.text: A wrong tap is undone in the Sales Log the same day. Never delete or hide a sale to make a figure match. Three points.

chapters.title: Receipts from MI or the Sales Log
chapters.text: Receipts come from M I or the Sales Log, never retyped into Customer Receipts. One point.

chapters.title: Past days: + Past sale and the right date
chapters.text: Past days only with plus Past sale and the right date. Never type the same sale twice. One point.

chapters.title: The laws and this video: 📜 Laws
chapters.text: Breaking a law costs penalty points, and the owner approves every sanction. The laws of this page, and this video, are on the Laws button.
